english.note: Use this when a person is unavailable because they are busy or not free.
Use this when someone is unavailable or has no free time, especially in a reply to a request.

examples.english: I’m unavailable today; I’ll get back to you tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我今日唔得閒，聽日先覆你。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4 ting1 jat6 sin1 fuk1 nei5

examples.english: Sorry, I'm busy right now; I'll call you later.
examples.traditional: 唔好意思，我而家唔得閒，遲啲再打畀你。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 m4 dak1 haan4 ci4 di1 zoi3 daa2 bei2 nei5
